tools.name: modelica_load
tools.description: Load Modelica libraries from file system paths. Must be called before using other tools.

tools.name: modelica_parse
tools.description: Parse inline Modelica source code and return a summary of classes, components, and any syntax errors.

tools.name: modelica_flatten
tools.description: Flatten a Modelica class to its DAE (Differential Algebraic Equation) form. Resolves inheritance, modifications, and produces the flat equation system and structural BLT/index-reduction metrics.

tools.name: modelica_lint
tools.description: Lint loaded Modelica libraries and return diagnostics (errors, warnings) with source locations.

tools.name: modelica_simulate
tools.description: Flatten and simulate a Modelica model, returning time-series results. Uses the high-performance arena simulation pipeline.

tools.name: hybrid_simulate
tools.description: Flatten and simulate a hybrid SysML v2 / Modelica system.

tools.name: modelica_doe
tools.description: Run a Design of Experiments on a Modelica model. Samples the parameter space and returns input-output datasets for response surface analysis or ROM training.

tools.name: modelica_sensitivity
tools.description: Run a One-At-a-Time (OAT) sensitivity analysis on a Modelica model. Perturbs each parameter individually and reports normalized sensitivity coefficients.

tools.name: modelica_query
tools.description: Introspect a Modelica class — returns its kind, description, components, extends hierarchy, and equations.

tools.name: validate_system_consistency
tools.description: Validates cross-domain consistency across SysML v2, Modelica, and the unified OWL2 ontology (port topology, SI/QUDV units, and shared parameter bindings).

tools.name: query_ontology_sparql
tools.description: Evaluate a SPARQL-DL or Property Path query against the unified polyglot ontology.

tools.name: query_ontology_bgp
tools.description: Evaluate a multi-pattern Basic Graph Pattern (BGP) query using Leapfrog Triejoin (Worst-Case Optimal Join).

tools.name: trace_fault_propagation
tools.description: Trace connections via transitive closure of the isConnectedTo property.

tools.name: explain_inference
tools.description: Get the axiom justification chain for why a SubClassOf relationship holds.

tools.name: tgg_query_thread
tools.description: Query multi-way digital thread alignments linking SysML v2, Modelica, CAD, and Requirements.

tools.name: tgg_diagnose_conflict
tools.description: Diagnose active multi-master concurrent edit conflicts with SMT bounds and physical feasibility.

tools.name: tgg_reconcile_slot
tools.description: Reconcile a multi-master cross-domain conflict slot using a physics-constrained or authority strategy and propagate updated parameter bindings across SysML v2 and Modelica.

tools.name: rtm_query_matrix
tools.description: Query the digital thread Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM) health, coverage percentages, and orphan requirements.

tools.name: rtm_suggest_links
tools.description: Suggest candidate architecture components to satisfy or verify an orphan requirement.

tools.name: rtm_diagnose_suspect
tools.description: Diagnose why a trace link was marked as suspect and suggest remediation actions.

tools.name: modelscript_closed_loop_synthesize
tools.description: Synthesize, tune, and certify a SysML v2 or Modelica model using Closed-Loop Compiler verification gates (1. Syntax, 2. QUDV Dimensions, 3. SMT Feasibility, 4. DAE Structural Balance, 5. Dynamic Simulation, STL Robustness & Parameter Tuning).

tools.name: modelscript_patch_code
tools.description: Surgically patch a model file by finding a specific searchBlock and replacing it with replaceBlock.

tools.name: modelscript_read_file
tools.description: Read file contents or a specific range of lines from a workspace file.

tools.name: modelscript_list_workspace_files
tools.description: List engineering model files in the workspace (Modelica, SysML, STEP, SCAD, CSV).

tools.name: modelica_diff_calibrate
tools.description: Calibrate Modelica model parameters against experimental or measurement curves using continuous DAE adjoint sensitivity and L-BFGS-B optimization.

tools.name: pscad_lint
tools.description: Lint a PSCAD project (.pscx, .pslx) or workspace (.pswx) file. Performs pre-flight electrical topology, parameter bounds, floating terminal, and weak grid (SCR) checks.

tools.name: pscad_simulate
tools.description: Simulate a PSCAD electromagnetic transient (EMT) circuit using the WebAssembly Dommel companion-circuit solver. Supports Bergeron lines, CDA switch damping, and OEM Inverter-Based Resource (IBR) FMUs.

tools.name: pscad_verify_ieee2800
tools.description: Automate IEEE 2800-2022 grid code compliance testing for Inverter-Based Resources (IBRs). Assesses momentary cessation, fast reactive current injection (T_90 <= 50 ms), and overvoltage ceiling (<= 1.20 pu).

tools.name: pscad_export
tools.description: Export a PSCAD project (.pscx, .pslx) to Modelica (OpenIPSL) or FMI/SSP (SystemStructure.ssd) for cross-domain digital thread interoperability.

tools.name: modelica_linearize
tools.description: Linearize a Modelica DAE model around an operating point or steady-state equilibrium to extract explicit LTI State-Space matrices (A, B, C, D), eigenvalues/poles, damping ratios, and stability margins.

tools.name: modelica_tune_pid
tools.description: Automatically tune a P, PI, or PID controller for a linearized Modelica plant model using Skogestad IMC (SIMC) and Sensitivity-Constrained Loop Shaping.

tools.name: olga_simulate
tools.description: Simulate transient multiphase flow, liquid accumulation, pressure drops, slugging, and pigging for an OLGA model (.opi, .key, .genkey).

tools.name: olga_lint
tools.description: Run pre-flight multiphase flow assurance diagnostics (M7001–M7007: CFL stability, steep risers, severe slugging dips, pig stuck hazard) on an OLGA model.

tools.name: olga_verify
tools.description: Formally verify multiphase simulation against flow assurance limits (MAOP, hydrate subcooling margin, and slug catcher capacity).

tools.name: olga_diagram
tools.description: Generate standalone SVG diagrams for an OLGA flowline: topological P&ID schematic or pipeline elevation bathymetry Z(X) with holdup heatmaps and active slugs/pigs.

tools.name: olga_parse_tpl
tools.description: Parse an OLGA simulation trend plot (.tpl) file or content into structured time-series dataset with variable catalog, units, and channel statistics.

tools.name: olga_parse_ppl
tools.description: Parse an OLGA spatial profile plot (.ppl) file or content into structured spatial snapshots along pipeline coordinate X with flow regimes and critical extrema.

tools.name: olga_tune
tools.description: Calibrate OLGA flowline model parameters (roughness, choke Cd, heat transfer, well PI) using autonomous Nelder-Mead simplex history matching against telemetry CSV observations.

tools.name: olga_gate
tools.description: Evaluate an automated Flow Assurance CI/CD Safety Gate check on an OLGA model for pull requests and operational envelope verification.

tools.name: olga_survey
tools.description: Ingest 3D seabed bathymetry survey coordinates (CSV with Easting,Northing,Depth or KP,Elevation) and discretize into adaptive curvature-aware OLGA pipe segments.

tools.name: gensys_lint
tools.description: Perform pre-flight semantic and physical validation on GENSYS railway vehicle models (.calc, .run, .sub).

tools.name: gensys_verify_en14363
tools.description: Verify derailment quotient (Y/Q <= 0.8) and Prud'homme lateral track shifting force limits according to EN 14363 / UIC 518.

tools.name: gensys_fastsim
tools.description: Compute tangential longitudinal/lateral creep forces and spin moment using Kalker's FASTSIM algorithm.

tools.name: simpack_lint
tools.description: Perform structural and reference diagnostics on SIMPACK XML (.spck) or classic deck (.sim, .mbs) files.

tools.name: simpack_mobility
tools.description: Calculate system degrees of freedom and overconstrained mechanisms using Grübler-Kutzbach spatial criterion.

tools.name: social_read_thread
tools.description: Read the conversation thread history, parent post, and attachments for a given social post ID.

tools.name: social_post_reply
tools.description: Post an engineering response or verification result to a social discussion thread on behalf of an authorized bot account.

tools.name: cad_fea_closed_loop_size
tools.description: Run closed-loop 3D CAD/OpenSCAD/STEP parametric sizing coupled with tetrahedral FEA von Mises stress analysis and BVH collision clearance verification.

tools.name: polyglot_migrate_and_verify_b2b
tools.description: Migrate legacy Simulink (.slx), SPICE (.cir), or MSC Adams (.adm) models to Modelica & SysML v2 and certify ISO 26262 Back-to-Back (B2B) trajectory & C99 equivalence.

tools.name: ssp_diagnose_cosim_stability
tools.description: Analyze an FMI 2.0/3.0 & SSP multi-FMU co-simulation topology for algebraic feedthrough loops, ZOH spectral radius instability, and synthesize stabilizing coupling schedules.

tools.name: formal_verify_safety_and_mcdc
tools.description: Prove unbounded safety invariants via IC3/PDR and Sum-of-Squares (SOS) barrier certificates, and generate DO-178C / ISO 26262 MC/DC independence-pair test vectors.

tools.name: twin_discover_sindy_and_rom
tools.description: Discover sparse nonlinear governing differential equations (SINDy) from hardware telemetry residuals and calibrate a Reduced-Order Model (ROM) digital twin.

tools.name: qif_inspect_and_spc
tools.description: Evaluates an ISO 23952 Quality Information Framework (QIF) document, runs NIST QIF & ASME Y14.5 GD&T lint checks, computes SPC capability (Cp/Cpk, TUR, MMC/LMC bonus tolerances), and optionally reconciles STEP AP242 entities.

tools.name: oscal_audit_cps_compliance
tools.description: Audits a NIST OSCAL document (Catalog, Profile, Component Definition, SSP, SAR, or POA&M) against NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 and SP 800-82 Rev 3 OT/ICS overlays, resolves profile baselines, and verifies cyber-physical architectural component coverage.

tools.name: aml_run_virtual_commissioning
tools.description: Parses an IEC 62714 AutomationML / CAEX workcell topology, runs semantic port & PPR role verification, and executes closed-loop virtual commissioning coupling VirtualPlc logic and mechatronic plant dynamics.

tools.name: opensim_analyze
tools.description: Parses an OpenSim (.osim) musculoskeletal biomechanics model, runs pre-flight kinematic and Hill-type muscle diagnostics (M9101–M9110), and simulates muscle activation/contraction dynamics.

tools.name: dicom_rt_verify_dvh
tools.description: Evaluates a DICOM-RT treatment plan (RTPLAN, RTSTRUCT, RTDOSE), verifies QUANTEC OAR dose constraints, MLC leaf kinematics, and gantry/couch collision clearance (M9201–M9210), and computes DVH, CI, HI, BED, and EQD2 metrics.

tools.name: cellml_simulate
tools.description: Parses a CellML 1.0/1.1/2.0 electrophysiology or microvascular perfusion model, verifies SI dimensional consistency and component interfaces (M9301–M9310), and integrates action potential / gating ODEs.

tools.name: igtl_verify_calibration
tools.description: Parses an OpenIGTLink / PLUS surgical navigation configuration, verifies SE(3) rotation orthogonality and coordinate frame connectivity (M9801–M9810), and solves stylus pivot calibration and Fitzpatrick Target Registration Error (TRE).

tools.name: three_mf_verify_guide
tools.description: Verifies an ISO/ASTM 52915 3MF Medical patient-specific surgical cutting guide or implant mesh for 2-manifold watertightness, outward normal volume, wall thickness, osteotomy plane normals, and biocompatibility (M9701–M9710).

tools.name: opendss_solve_powerflow
tools.description: Solves multi-phase unbalanced distribution AC power flow using sparse Ybus nodal admittance matrix with RegControl tap changers and CapControl capacitor banks.

tools.name: opendss_solve_faults
tools.description: Computes short-circuit fault currents (3-phase symmetrical, single line-to-ground SLG, line-to-line LL) and Thevenin equivalent impedances.

tools.name: opendss_evaluate_harmonics
tools.description: Computes frequency-dependent harmonic voltage propagation and total harmonic distortion (THD%) across user-specified harmonic spectrum.

tools.name: opendss_analyze_reliability
tools.description: Evaluates predictive distribution feeder reliability indices (IEEE 1366: SAIFI, SAIDI, CAIDI, ASAI, EEN) and identifies critical risk branches.

tools.name: opendss_solve_gic
tools.description: Analyzes geomagnetically induced currents (GIC) from space weather events across power grid substation earth grounds and identifies transformer half-cycle saturation risks.

tools.name: opendss_hosting_capacity
tools.description: Calculates distribution feeder maximum Distributed Energy Resource (DER) hosting capacity limited by ANSI C84.1 voltage rise and line thermal capacity, with optional IEEE 1547 smart inverter Volt-VAR mitigation.

tools.name: opendss_simulate_flisr
tools.description: Simulates automated Fault Location, Isolation, and Service Restoration (FLISR) distribution grid self-healing, calculating customer interruption hours saved.

tools.name: epanet_solve_hydraulics
tools.description: Solves steady-state or extended period hydraulics for a US EPA EPANET water distribution network (.inp).
tools.category: Municipal Water, Stormwater & Leak Localization (EPANET / SWMM)

tools.name: epanet_fire_flow_analysis
tools.description: Performs fire flow capacity analysis at a municipal hydrant node, evaluating available GPM at 20 psi residual pressure.
tools.category: Municipal Water, Stormwater & Leak Localization (EPANET / SWMM)

tools.name: epanet_outage_contingency
tools.description: Simulates N-1 pipe break isolation and unsupplied customer demand under Pressure-Dependent Demand (PDD).
tools.category: Municipal Water, Stormwater & Leak Localization (EPANET / SWMM)

tools.name: epanet_screen_contingencies_webgpu
tools.description: Parallelizes thousands of N-1 pipe break isolations and hydrant fire flow capacity tests simultaneously using WebGPU compute shaders with CPU SIMD fallback.
tools.category: Municipal Water, Stormwater & Leak Localization (EPANET / SWMM)

tools.name: epanet_water_hammer_surge
tools.description: Simulates acoustic pressure wave propagation, Joukowsky surge spikes, column separation (DVCM), and 4-quadrant pump trip dynamics via the Method of Characteristics (MOC).
tools.category: Municipal Water, Stormwater & Leak Localization (EPANET / SWMM)

tools.name: water_audit_awwa_m36
tools.description: Performs standard AWWA M36 Water Audit calculating CARL, UARL, Infrastructure Leakage Index (ILI), and non-revenue water financial losses.
tools.category: Municipal Water, Stormwater & Leak Localization (EPANET / SWMM)

tools.name: epanet_optimize_cip
tools.description: Optimizes multi-year Capital Improvement Planning (CIP) pipe replacement and upsizing to maximize hydraulic performance under strict budget constraints.
tools.category: Municipal Water, Stormwater & Leak Localization (EPANET / SWMM)

tools.name: epanet_calibrate_scada
tools.description: Calibrates EPANET pipe Hazen-Williams roughness C-factors against real-world SCADA telemetry pressure observations.
tools.category: Municipal Water, Stormwater & Leak Localization (EPANET / SWMM)

tools.name: epanet_gis_to_model
tools.description: Ingests municipal GIS pipe centerlines, junction assets, and digital elevation models (DEM) from GeoJSON / ASCII grids into a complete, ready-to-solve EPANET network (.inp).
tools.category: Municipal Water, Stormwater & Leak Localization (EPANET / SWMM)

tools.name: swmm_flood_routing
tools.description: Simulates 1D Saint-Venant dynamic wave routing in an urban stormwater or combined sewer network (.inp), reporting peak flows and flooding.
tools.category: Municipal Water, Stormwater & Leak Localization (EPANET / SWMM)

tools.name: swmm_simulate_rtc
tools.description: Simulates Real-Time Control (RTC) gate/weir/pump modulation for urban Combined Sewer Overflow (CSO) mitigation.
tools.category: Municipal Water, Stormwater & Leak Localization (EPANET / SWMM)

tools.name: swmm_gis_to_model
tools.description: Ingests municipal GIS stormwater/wastewater conduits, manholes, catchment polygon boundaries, and DEM rasters from GeoJSON / ASCII grids into a complete SWMM network (.inp).
tools.category: Municipal Water, Stormwater & Leak Localization (EPANET / SWMM)

tools.name: epanet_convert_watergems
tools.description: Extracts water distribution and surge models directly from Bentley WaterGEMS / HAMMER (.wtg.sqlite) or InfoWater databases into native EPANET AST and .inp deck.
tools.category: Municipal Water, Stormwater & Leak Localization (EPANET / SWMM)

tools.name: swmm_convert_infoworks
tools.description: Extracts collection system models directly from Autodesk / Innovyze InfoWorks ICM database tables into a native SWMM network AST and .inp deck.
tools.category: Municipal Water, Stormwater & Leak Localization (EPANET / SWMM)

tools.name: swmm_inundation_2d
tools.description: Simulates 2D shallow water surface inundation and street overland flooding coupled dynamically to 1D SWMM surcharged manholes (InfoWorks ICM Parity).
tools.category: Municipal Water, Stormwater & Leak Localization (EPANET / SWMM)

tools.name: ecad_dfm_audit
tools.description: Runs Design for Manufacturing, Assembly, and Test (DFM/DFA/DFT) design rule checks on PCB layout data.
tools.category: ECAD, PCB Signal Integrity & Supply-Chain BOM

tools.name: ecad_generate_manufacturing_bundle
tools.description: Generates complete, verified manufacturing files (IPC-2581C, ODB++ v8.1, Gerbers, and Centroid PnP) from PCB layout.
tools.category: ECAD, PCB Signal Integrity & Supply-Chain BOM

tools.name: supply_chain_scrub_bom
tools.description: Scrubs a Bill of Materials across multi-tier distributors (Nexar, Digi-Key, Mouser) to calculate extended pricing, stock availability, lead times, and obsolescence risks.
tools.category: ECAD, PCB Signal Integrity & Supply-Chain BOM

tools.name: optical_inspect_otdr
tools.description: Inspects a Telcordia GR-196/SR-4731 .sor Optical Time-Domain Reflectometer (OTDR) binary file or base64 data to extract fiber span attenuation, event loss, reflectance, and splice integrity.
tools.category: Telecom, DWDM Optical, 5G RAN & Outside-Plant Fiber

tools.name: optical_solve_transmission
tools.description: Solves multi-span optical DWDM transmission performance using the Generalized Gaussian Noise (EGN) non-linear model, computing GSNR, ASE noise, NLI power, and CD accumulation.
tools.category: Telecom, DWDM Optical, 5G RAN & Outside-Plant Fiber

tools.name: ran_solve_microwave_budget
tools.description: Solves line-of-sight microwave link budget, Free Space Path Loss (FSPL), ITU-R P.530 rain fade, Fresnel clearance, and annual availability percentage ('five-nines' verification).
tools.category: Telecom, DWDM Optical, 5G RAN & Outside-Plant Fiber

tools.name: fiber_locate_otdr_fault
tools.description: Pinpoints the exact physical GIS GPS latitude/longitude of an optical fiber break or event measured by OTDR, correcting for cable helix twisting and vault slack loops.
tools.category: Telecom, DWDM Optical, 5G RAN & Outside-Plant Fiber

tools.name: ran_evaluate_mpe_safety
tools.description: Evaluates FCC OET-65, Health Canada Safety Code 6, ICNIRP 2020, EU CENELEC, Swiss NISV, and Italian CEI 211 maximum permissible exposure (MPE) for cellular and microwave base station sites. Computes power densities, exclusion boundary distances (General Population vs. Occupational), Total Exposure Ratio (TER <= 1.0), and OSHA/FCC warning signage requirements.
tools.category: Telecom, DWDM Optical, 5G RAN & Outside-Plant Fiber

tools.name: ran_evaluate_faa_obstruction
tools.description: Evaluates FAA 14 CFR Part 77, ICAO Annex 14 Volume I, and Transport Canada CAR 601.23 airspace obstruction notice criteria for telecom towers, calculates runway slope penetrations, and generates structured filing notice data.
tools.category: Telecom, DWDM Optical, 5G RAN & Outside-Plant Fiber

tools.name: fiber_evaluate_pole_loading
tools.description: Evaluates utility pole structural loading pursuant to US NESC Rule 250/260, Canadian CSA C22.3 No. 1, or European Eurocode EN 50341 / EN 1991-1-4. Computes bending moment capacity, conductor transverse/ice loads, and percent pole capacity utilization.
tools.category: Telecom, DWDM Optical, 5G RAN & Outside-Plant Fiber

tools.name: fiber_generate_bdc_fabric
tools.description: Generates FCC Broadband Data Collection (BDC) and NTIA BEAD compliant spatial datasets discretized into Uber H3 Resolution 8 or 9 hexagonal bins from geographic fiber routes or service polygon points.
tools.category: Telecom, DWDM Optical, 5G RAN & Outside-Plant Fiber

tools.name: telecom_evaluate_nors_outage
tools.description: Evaluates whether a telecom network outage meets mandatory FCC Part 4 (47 CFR § 4.9) NORS reporting thresholds (900,000 user-minutes, 911/PSAP facility impact, or major transport cut) and generates an automated electronic filing dossier.
tools.category: Telecom, DWDM Optical, 5G RAN & Outside-Plant Fiber

tools.name: modelscript_bifurcation_continuation
tools.description: Traces nonlinear steady-state equilibrium curves F(x, p) = 0 via Pseudo-Arclength Continuation (PALC) and detects Fold (LP), Hopf (HB), and Branch (BP) bifurcations.

tools.name: modelscript_stochastic_jump
tools.description: Executes discrete-state stochastic chemical/epidemiological jump simulations using Gillespie Direct SSA, First-Reaction SSA, or Cao-Gillespie-Petzold Adaptive Tau-Leaping.

tools.name: comtrade_extract_phasor
tools.description: Extract dynamic discrete Fourier transform (DFT) RMS phasors from IEEE C37.111 COMTRADE records.

tools.name: scl_validate_goose
tools.description: Validate IEC 61850 GOOSE and Sampled Values publisher/subscriber communication stream latency and dataflow.

tools.name: waterml_fit_rating_curve
tools.description: Fit a non-linear stage-discharge power-law rating curve Q = a * (h - h0)^b from hydrologic stage/discharge pairs.

tools.name: atp_simulate_transient
tools.description: Simulate electromagnetic transient companion-matrix trapezoidal response from an ATP-EMTP card deck.

tools.name: dnp3_process_telemetry
tools.description: Filter telemetry analog stream using IEEE 1815 / DNP3 deadband thresholding and evaluate signal reconstruction.

tools.name: oneliner_calculate_fault
tools.description: Calculate symmetrical components 3-phase and SLG short-circuit fault currents from ASPEN OneLiner (.olx/.dxt) cases.

tools.name: sel_evaluate_protection
tools.description: Evaluate Schweitzer Engineering Laboratories (SEL) relay trip logic, 50P instantaneous, and 51P TOC curves.

tools.name: hec_hms_simulate_runoff
tools.description: Simulate SCS Runoff Curve Number (CN) excess precipitation and unit hydrograph outflow from HEC-HMS basin models.

tools.name: asm_evaluate_biokinetics
tools.description: Evaluate IWA Activated Sludge Model (ASM1) biological process rates and net substrate/biomass conversion rates.
